definitions.explanation: A performance given as an invited guest with a group or company one does not normally belong to, as when a conductor, actor, or musician appears with another ensemble or theater. Takes する to mean to make such an appearance.

examples.japanese: {有名|ゆうめい}な{指揮者|しきしゃ}が{客演|きゃくえん}する。
examples.english: A famous conductor will make a guest appearance.

examples.japanese: {今回|こんかい}の{公演|こうえん}には{海外|かいがい}の{歌手|かしゅ}が{客演|きゃくえん}する。
examples.english: A singer from overseas will make a guest appearance in this performance.

examples.japanese: {彼女|かのじょ}は{別|べつ}の{劇団|げきだん}に{客演|きゃくえん}して、{主役|しゅやく}を{演|えん}じた。
examples.english: She made a guest appearance with another theater company and played the lead role.

notes:
Used of the performing arts — concerts, theater, opera, ballet. The guest is invited from outside the regular company for a particular production.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {客演|きゃくえん}{指揮者|しきしゃ}: guest conductor
- {客演|きゃくえん}する: to appear as a guest performer
- {客演|きゃくえん}を{迎|むか}える: to welcome a guest performer

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {出演|しゅつえん}: appearing/performing (in general) — does not imply being an outside guest
- {共演|きょうえん}: co-starring — performing together with others, from the performers' point of view
